nights.title: Luca Fogale
nights.name: Luca Fogale
nights.extract: Luca Fogale is a Canadian pop singer-songwriter from Burnaby, British Columbia. He is most noted for his 2020 album Nothing Is Lost, which was a Juno Award nominee for Adult Contemporary Album of the Year at the Juno Awards of 2022.
